REPAIR: determine send-call capability before the first dispatch, not by retrying after an exception. Normalize injected send functions at Runner construction or through an explicit adapter so each logical call executes the callback exactly once. Keep transport failures as an explicit result/error class emitted by HttpTransport rather than inferring transport health from `http_status is None`.
